purpose: Test the user's hypothesis that the r4 C02/C03 failures were model-dependent by changing only the selected model from Qwen to Luna.

acceptance.C02: served web application rejects valid CON.pdf before storage and accepts report.pdf; relevant tests and build pass
acceptance.C03: real Chromium preview renders a PDF canvas without a blocked iframe page; no source change unless the defect is reproduced

interpretation: Results may identify a model effect for these two cases. They do not overwrite the Qwen comparison, constitute a full v3 release comparison, or reopen v0-v2 acceptance.
